messages:
Avery Chen: FYI — we just received a partial shipment for PO-89211, 48 units received but serial audit shows 6 units with mismatched SKUs (L40x vs L40). Can we pause staging for APAC until we sort? :thinking:
Samir Patel: ugh. which site? do we have AWB/manifest?
Avery Chen: SIN staging. AWB: 787-5543210. Manifest attached earlier in the PO thread.
Nisha Rao: @Samir can you check whether mismatch is packaging label only or actual hardware? If hardware wrong we need RMA path.
Samir Patel: opening a quick bench test now. If FW/part numbers match it's labeling, otherwise RMA. ETA ~2h.
Marco (NexaSupply): Marco here — we shipped a mixed revision to meet the shipment window. We logged the L40 vs L40x discrepancy on our side (manual pack error). We can either (1) swap the 6 units next flight (ETA 5 business days) or (2) issue credit and dispatch refurbished top-offs from EU pool (ETA 3 business days) with 5% restocking fee waiver.
Avery Chen: cost/credit numbers? finance needs delta for decision.
Marco (NexaSupply): swap cost covered by us. Charter expedite option +$9k per unit if you need <48h delivery. Refurb option: deduct $3k/unit from invoice, units have full burn-in and verified SMART.
Nisha Rao: Ops question: can refurbished units meet our certification for Dedicated pools? We prefer new for Dedicated customers.
Marco (NexaSupply): Understandable. Refurbs are validated to our QA-2 spec; we can run extra burn-in at our depot and provide extended 6-month warranty.
Samir Patel: bench shows 2 of the 6 actually read as L40 (non-x) hardware. Others have label mismatch only. So 2 RMA candidates.
Avery Chen: ok — proposal: accept the 4 that only need relabeling, request immediate swap for the 2 wrong HW. Ask vendor to cover swap shipping and priority customs docs. If vendor insists on refurb top-offs, we need written warranty and SLA.
Marco (NexaSupply): agreed. We'll pick up the 2 DOA replacements on our DDP and send replacement L40x units via next flight. I'll attach AWB and customs invoice by EOD.
Logistics Bot: Shipment update: AWB 787-5543210 cleared customs (SIN) at 09:12. Hold code: HS-MATCH-REVIEW. Next flight availability: 2024-12-03.
Nisha Rao: can legal OK the warranty extension language quickly? cc @Avery
Avery Chen: looping in legal separately. For now Ops approves swap plan. Samir — log units into quarantine and tag with DOA-1713345678.
Samir Patel: done. Quarantine tags applied, serial list: SNL-A1..SNL-A6 added to sheet.
Avery Chen: thanks. Marco — please send formal credit/expedite options and a commitment to cover customs reprocessing if vendor error causes delay. We need that in writing to release staging.
Marco (NexaSupply): will send contract addendum + AWB and customs docs within 4 business hours.
Nisha Rao: one more ask — add insurance claim option in case the replacements are damaged in transit, and confirm carrier liability.
Marco (NexaSupply): confirmed. Carrier declared value will match invoice and we will file for insurance if needed.
Avery Chen: great. I'll mark this thread as pending vendor docs and update stakeholders after papers arrive. :thumbsup:
